title: Guest and Caregiver Meal Prices and Allowances on the Dining Plan
content:
Residents on the Dining Plan may bring guests and a private caregiver to the restaurant. Guest meals and caregiver meals have their own prices, and some plans allow them to be covered by meal credits or include complimentary guest meals each month.

## Price list and allowances by plan

| Plan | Guest meal price, paid in money (USD per meal) | Guest meals may be redeemed with credits | Most guest meals per month redeemable with credits | Complimentary guest meals per month | Caregiver meal price (USD per meal) | Caregiver meals may be redeemed with credits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 15.95 | No | 0 | 0 | 9.95 | No |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 15.95 | No | 0 | 0 | 9.95 | No |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 15.95 | Yes | 4 | 1 | 9.95 | No |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 15.95 | Yes | 6 | 1 | 9.95 | Yes |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 15.95 | Yes | 8 | 2 | 9.95 | Yes |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 15.95 | Yes | 12 | 4 | 9.95 | Yes |

A complimentary guest meal is provided without charge and without a credit. A caregiver meal is the meal of a private caregiver accompanying the resident.

## Questions answered from the table

**Does any plan include complimentary guest meals?** Yes: the Dining 30 Meal Plan and the Dining 45 Meal Plan include 1 a month, the Dining 60 Meal Plan 2 and the Dining Full Board Plan 4. The Dining 10 Meal Plan and the Dining 15 Meal Plan include none.

**On which plans may guest meals be covered by credits?** On the Dining 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan, up to 4, 6, 8 and 12 guest meals a month respectively. On the Dining 10 Meal Plan and the Dining 15 Meal Plan they may not.

**On which plans may a caregiver's meal be covered by credits?** On the Dining 45 Meal Plan, the Dining 60 Meal Plan and the Dining Full Board Plan. On the other three plans the caregiver meal price of 9.95 US dollars applies.

**Is the guest meal price the same on every plan?** Yes, 15.95 US dollars per meal on all six plans.
